verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents its own mail handling: a physical business address with unlimited incoming mail, scans and recycling, a registered-agent service, and an ambiguous 'send via paper mail' feature. None of this establishes a documented policy for forwarding originals, certified mail or checks to the company. missing for 10: a documented original-document forwarding policy, explicit certified-mail and check handling, forwarding timelines and costs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
